fields.name: Name
fields.consent: I agree that my details are used only to reply to this request.

placeholders.name: Full name
placeholders.message: Briefly describe the need, timing, and context

hints.phoneOrEmail: At least one of phone or email is required.

errors.nameRequired: Name is missing. Enter at least 2 characters, then send again.
errors.nameMax: Name is too long. Shorten it to 80 characters or fewer.
errors.contactRequired: Phone and email are both empty. Add at least one so we can reply.
errors.phoneInvalid: That phone number is not valid. Fix the format, or leave it blank and use email.
errors.emailInvalid: That email is not valid. Correct it, or leave it blank and use phone.
errors.serviceRequired: No service is selected. Choose one option from the list.
errors.stageRequired: Project stage is missing. Pick the option that matches your situation.
errors.messageRequired: The message is too short. Add at least 10 characters so we understand the need.
errors.messageMax: The message exceeds 2000 characters. Shorten it, then send again.
errors.consentRequired: Consent is not checked. Tick the consent box so we can send the request.

status.success: Your message was received. We will contact you shortly to coordinate next steps.
status.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes, then send again.
status.misconfigured: Sending is temporarily unavailable. Try later or use another channel.
status.upstream: The server could not accept the message. Try again shortly; your typed data is still here.
status.validation: Some fields need attention. Fix the highlighted items, then send again.
status.network: Could not connect. Check your network and send again; your typed data is kept.
status.generic: Sending failed. Try again; if it persists, use another channel.
status.tryChannel: You can also reach us here:
status.tryLater: Your typed data is still in the form—retry shortly or use the contact details beside the form.
